Step 1 - Decide how to host your page
You can do any of the following options:
Purchase your own domain and host it for free
Purchase your own domain and pay to host it
Figure out what you want your page to be about.  It can specialize in a certain area or cover a broad range of topics.
Create or find a layout that you like
Write the content that you will have for your web page.
Use a WYSIWYG editor to create your web page or learn some HTML to creat the page
Step 3 - Test and validate your web site
Once you have the web site looking how you want it you should test it in other browsers and on other
platforms if possible to insure that everyone will be able to use your site.  It is also wise to spellcheck your
page and run it through an HTML validator to make sure that you haven't made any mistakes.
- Many times when viewing a page visitors will want to know who created the content they're reading.
You can include a little information about yourself and why you created it.
- It is a good practice to get in the habit of to have a clearly visible way for a visitor to contact you.  That
way if they have a question they won't have to scour the site just to find it.
